threat_intelligence.threat_actor: UNC2452 / APT29 / Nobelium / Cozy Bear (Russia SVR)
threat_intelligence.attack_type: Software Supply Chain Compromise (MITRE ATT&CK T1195.002)
threat_intelligence.injection_vector: Trojanized MSBuild source modification prior to assembly compilation (SUNSPOT injector)
threat_intelligence.dormancy_window: 12 to 14 days delay prior to active command execution

crypto_obfuscation_parameters.string_algorithm: Raw Deflate decompression over Base64 payload

incident_chronology.event: Attackers gain unauthorized persistent access to SolarWinds internal network.
Harmless test code injected into Orion build to validate POC injection mechanism.
SUNBURST backdoor code injected into the active Orion build system via SUNSPOT.
Signed, trojanized software updates (v2020.2.1 HF 1) shipped to 18,000 customers.
FireEye publicly discloses breach of its internal red-team tooling.
SUNBURST supply chain intrusion publicly disclosed; CISA Emergency Directive 21-01 issued.
United States formally attributes campaign to Russian Foreign Intelligence Service (SVR).
